## Checklist

- [ ] `make fmt vet test` passes locally
- [ ] Added/updated tests (a new rule comes with a dangerous case **and** a safe case that must stay quiet)
- [ ] The rule stays quiet on ordinary, everyday commands (no false-positive nagging)
- [ ] No new dependency added (or it's justified in the summary above)
- [ ] Updated docs / `docs/rules.md` / `CHANGELOG.md` if user-facing
